0.q: We showed that both Vc-NhaA and Vc-NhaB confer Na+ resistance

1.q: These results strongly suggest that NhaA is an Na+/H+ antiporter contributing to the Na+/H+ homeostasis of V. cholerae.
Deletion of the nhaA gene in E. coli impairs cell growth at alkaline pH in the presence of NaCl or LiCl.

2.q: we identified two additional antiporter genes, designated Vc-nhaB and Vc-nhaD, encoding two putative proteins of 530 and 477 residues
